announcement: New small batch now open for orders
tagline: Clothing and jewellery made slowly, by hand, in small batches — for the woman who would rather own one piece she loves than ten she doesn't.
clothing_blurb: Linen dresses, hand-finished blouses and easy silhouettes cut in small runs — soft pastel and botanical prints designed to be lived in, not just looked at.
jewellery_blurb: Delicate gold-vermeil chains, freshwater pearls and hand-set stones — pieces meant to be layered, passed down, and worn every single day.
story_heading: A cottage, a needle, and a name
story_body:
Denora began the way most small things do — at a kitchen table, with fabric off-cuts and a box of beads, and no plan beyond making something beautiful with the time we had.

Every dress is still cut by hand. Every clasp is still set one at a time. We keep the batches small on purpose: it's the only way to make sure nothing leaves the cottage that we wouldn't wear ourselves.
